title: Real physical changed-context memory vs matched autoregressive and online residual controls
north_star: Tokenless native causal learning, with explicit advisory separation from native runtime. Offline standalone research only.
hypothesis: After FIT-only training on real actuator walk, selective contradiction-gated residual memory can adapt faster to a previously unseen real physical sensor-parameter regime change while preserving frozen old readout, and beat the strongest equal-public-data conventional static and online residual controls.

source.license: CC BY 4.0 physical CSV; MIT experiment generator; attribution Gamella/Peters/Bühlmann, NMI 2025, DOI 10.1038/s42256-024-00964-x

frozen_custody.visibility: Five current manipulable actuators load_in,load_out,hatch,pot_1,pot_2; previous observed rpm_in and pressure_intake only; current rpm_in/pressure_intake strictly withheld until loss computed. No flag or true regime target names to model. Timestamp/counter evaluator custody only.
frozen_custody.regimes: Regime 0 is original physical reference; regimes 1..31 are parameter interventions in the same tunnel, not proof of novel causal mechanism. Evaluate first 200 observations of each regime 1..31 as frozen changed-context adaptation window and all 320000 observations independently.

methods.normalization: FIT-only means and population-standard deviations for input and output columns. Missing/zero/nonfinite standard deviations terminate before scoring.
methods.training: Program normalized linear ARX weights via recursive ridge least-squares on FIT; compare to independently fully fitted batch ridge, same 8 features (intercept, 5 actuator values, prior two public sensor values) and FIT, lambda=0.01, parity tolerance 0.00001 coefficient.
conventional_controls: same-info online residual EMA with 2 output scalar biases, update alpha=0.2 on past measured errors
methods.candidate: same directly programmed ARX weights, plus per-output contradiction gate: normalized previous-error >1.5 FIT residual standard deviation for three consecutive observations; only then update bias = 0.8*oldbias+0.2*past_error; otherwise bias*=0.98. At time t, bias already updated only from observations strictly before t; gate never sees current withheld output.
methods.capacity: candidate adds two scalar biases and two integer mismatch counters; EMA adds two scalar biases; report capacity difference rather than claiming exact matched memory capacity.
methods.scoring: Per-output FIT normalized RMSE; lower is better. On walk public DEV seeds9-10 and changed-context regime first200 per regime1..31, plus all regime1..31. Strongest control for dev is the minimum scored *per output* across all available FIT-trained conventional controls (conservative oracle reporting; not a deployable selector). Fixed hyperparameters, no post-result adjustment.
methods.retention: Preserve SHA256 of frozen base model and 32 fixed old-walk-DEV checkpoint predictions before and after streaming new-regime observations; zero byte/prediction drift. This is SOFTWARE COLD PRESERVATION, not proof of behavioral retention under re-learning.
methods.first_pass: Source parser/schema and 6-FIT trained batch vs RLS parity engineering
methods.second_pass: Single immutable PUBLIC DEV run of contradiction gate vs conventional, no further tuning if negative
methods.source_substitution: No surrogate/synthetic scientific results; small hand-authored fixtures permitted solely to unit-test parser and no-current-target leakage.
methods.scientific_acceptance: Not admitted, this is offline public developer evidence. SCIENTIFIC_PASS is always false; never claim original first-use, native Yggdrasil integration, autonomous intervention selection, unfamiliar-world transfer or physical energy savings.
